entry: Fixed DEF-001: overdue() now uses strict < so a task due today is not flagged OVERDUE; test_due_today_is_not_overdue green.
Fixed DEF-002: quarantined the flaky clock test by rewriting it as a deterministic tracker.add() round-trip with a tolerance window and temp DB; suite 4/4 green.
Implemented the history command (WBS-2): tracker.history(id) prints added/done timestamps; covered by test_add_list_done_history_round_trip.
Implemented FR-007 (SC-001 approved drift): tick export --csv writes open+done tasks as CSV to stdout; test_export_csv_includes_open_and_done green (suite 6/6).
SL-001 closed: readiness clean (AC-001 Met, WBS-2 Implemented after verification), slice transitioned to Implemented.
FORCED transition: SL-002 -> Implemented past blocking readiness failures (acs-met (1)) — operator-confirmed override
GATE-001 (ready, SL-002) decided Go — operator: seed tests triaged before SL-002 work (DEF-001/DEF-002/DEF-003 registered, suite deterministic).
GATE-002 (approval) decided Go — operator approves the MVP for team rollout (SL-001 clean, SL-002 shipped under WVR-001 with AC-003 open).

FIXTURE FIX (plan 040, after beat 13): AC-004 was bound to FR-004 (task history) by the beat brief's error while its statement describes the CSV export (FR-007); Approved ACs are immutable, so AC-005 supersedes it bound to FR-007 and carries the Pending placeholder; AC-004 retired_in 1.

Beat 14 (plan 041, v4.7.0 RC): entity_export wrote exports/slate-rows.json (AC-003, AC-005) stamped with digest 48e5d2e35cf1ff9a43340f629d07fa21ea5823eab9f3b5f547c6c4cda65a29b3 == package_verify(); workspace/scripts/gen-slate.py rendered workspace/slate.html from that file and calibrated its verifier (one corrupted character detected). The paste guard: a full-row DEF-001 upsert with expect_unchanged [title] and ONE word of the title altered (flagged -> marked) was REFUSED naming title; the same row with the exact stored title and severity high -> medium was ACCEPTED, then severity restored to high under expect_unchanged [title] (accepted); the title re-read byte-identical. Also observed: the PARTIAL export note (verdicts.json, limit 1 of 5), the data/ path refusal and the read-only-tools refusal.

Beat 15 (plan 059, v4.8.0 RC): the advisor-audit mechanisms fired against the recorded package. NAMES (plan 044): package_open("../package") was REFUSED — invalid package name '../package' (kebab-case, [a-z0-9-], one segment) — and nothing was opened. THE STALE-TREE ROLLBACK (plan 043): one character was hand-edited inside RISK-001's title while the package was open; entity_upsert(RISK-002) was REFUSED — data/ changed on disk since this session loaded it (risks.jsonl) — refusing to overwrite — the batch was NOT applied; entity_query("risk") showed no RISK-002, package_close warned it closed WITHOUT the final flush, and risks.jsonl was restored byte-for-byte from the pre-beat backup (package_verify: verified true). BORN-IMPLEMENTED (plan 053): slice SL-003 "Export polish" was REFUSED — readiness: SL-003 cannot be created as Implemented — then accepted under force, and the server appended its own typed forced-override row PE-020 naming born-Implemented. THE WHOLE-RULE WAIVER: WVR-002 on defects-minor with no applies_to made the rule read waived and its waived list name every open minor defect (DEF-003, DEF-004). THE OMISSION REVISION (plan 051): the invariant omission's reason was rewritten and the second write landed ok, never unchanged. THE CSV GUARD (plan 050): DEF-004's formula-shaped title exports to csv/defects.csv quote-prefixed while review.html renders it unchanged. THE NOTE SCREEN (plan 054): skill SKL-002, named after the classic prompt-injection phrase, blocked handoff_emit at gate G-INJECT with a skill finding; re-upserting SKL-002 as Obsolete let the emit through and the note's skills line names only boundary-semantics.

FORCED lock removal: data/.lock held by pid 366344 on Anas-PC since 2026-09-21T04:48:00+00:00 was observed `not-running` - no process with pid 366344 is running on this host - and removed on the operator's word (package_unlock confirm=true)

Beat 16 - the findings_25 continuation (v4.9.0). A child process took data/.lock naming itself and exited; package_open REFUSED and said what it saw - "observed: not-running - no process with pid 366344 is running on this host" - while the read-only package_migrate preview still answered ("read while locked"). package_unlock reported first (would_unlock: true, nothing written), then on this plan's operator word removed the lock and journaled PE-022 (forced-override, actor system:package-unlock). A lock naming a LIVE holder was then planted and REFUSED: "the lock's holder was observed `alive` (pid 370136 is the very process that wrote the lock (exact start identity)) - not removed"; that lock was removed by hand, as the tool says is the deliberate path. The legible reads: server_info(detail=true) names 37 entity types and the mitigates rule's endpoints; a projection of defect to id+title reported omitted_columns [severity, lifecycle_status, found_in, fixed_by, custom_attributes, last_referenced] and a search for SL-002 reported matched {DEF-001..DEF-004: [found_in]} - it said WHERE it matched, in a column it had not returned; defects-closed reported its population (defects, 4 rows, unscoped) and lessons-confirmed its own (lessons, 2 rows). DEF-005 was then written with a phantom id in its prose and readiness caught it - prose-ids-resolve: "DEF-005.title -> RISK-909" - and passed again once the title was corrected (DEF-001, a real row, was never flagged). entity_export wrote exports/beat16-defects.json whose envelope says partial: true (1 of 5 rows), and package_verify(expect=<that digest>) confirmed matches_expected: true. A retired table's csv/prompts.csv and an operator's csv/operator-notes.csv were planted by hand: package_verify named both as foreign_csv, export_html removed the first and left the second alone as unowned. handoff_emit(refresh_stock=true) carried five stale stock bodies - README.md, integrity-check.md, orient-resume.md, register-liveness.md, replan-deferred.md - to their 4.9.0 text, with nothing customized to preserve.
